title: Gulf Shore Manor
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A vacation rental at ‘Gulf Shore Manor’ a Luxury 8-Bedroom, 7 full & 2 half Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 30 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Private Beach Access & Golf Cart for your enjoyment.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Second Floor Private Pool + Water feature (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Carriage House with Kitchenette • Outdoor Dining with Grilling Station • Deeded Beach Access • Elevator • Multiple Balconies and with exquisite Gulf Views • Game Room with Ping Pong Table • Six-Seater Golf Cart & Six Adult Bikes Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS / LAYOUT FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 16) • Bedroom 1: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities and Glass/Tile Shower • Bedroom 2: Bunk Room with Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds & One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed (sleeps 10) with ensuite Bathroom - Double vanities & Shower/Tub Combo • Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities and Glass/Tile Shower • Sitting Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) • Laundry Room with Frontload Washer & Dryer + Sink and Storage • Elevator • Half Bathroom with Custom Sink SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 4: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities and Glass/Tile Shower • Living Room with 2 Large Sectionals & Gas Fireplace • Dining room with 2 Large Dining Tables – Each Seats 8 (16 Total) • Wet Bar and Wine Fridge • Culinary Kitchen with Large Island – Seats 4 • Half Bathroom with Custom Sink THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 8) • Bedroom 5: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with & Large Contemporary Shower • Bedroom 6: Bunk Room with Two Twin over Twin Bunks (sleeps 4) • Bedroom 7: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) • Shared Bathroom with Double Vanities & Shower/Tub Combo • Sitting Area with Wet Bar (Ice Maker, Sink & Wine Fridge) CARRIAGE HOUSE: (sleeps 4) • Bedroom 8: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity and Shower/Tub Combo • Sitting Area: Queen Sleep Sofa (sleeps 2) • Kitchenette and Dining Area for 2 • Game Room Garage with Ping Pong Table DESCRIPTION: ‘Gulf Shore Manor’ is an exquisite 8-bedroom, 7-full & 2-half bathroom vacation retreat nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach along renowned 30A. This luxurious home and carriage house offers spacious, airy interiors with an open-concept design, perfect for large gatherings or multi-family vacations. Comfortably accommodating up to 30 guests, ‘Gulf Shore Manor’ not only a home, but a coastal haven designed for relaxation and rejuvenation. With easy access to nearby shops, restaurants, and attractions, it’s the ideal destination for those seeking both tranquility and adventure along Florida's beautiful Gulf Coast. The expansive living area is tastefully decorated with coastal-inspired furnishings, featuring large windows that flood the space with natural light and offer serene views of the Gulf. The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances, ample counter space, and an oversized island, ideal for preparing meals and entertaining guests. Each of the eight bedrooms is a private oasis, featuring plush bedding and thoughtful décor that reflects the tranquil beachside setting. Several rooms boast en-suite bathrooms and private balconies perfect for sipping a morning cup of coffee while listening to the tranquil wave. The seven bathrooms are modern and elegant and are composed of premium finishes to provide a spa-like experience. Step outside to the expansive outdoor area, where a second-floor private pool awaits, surrounded by comfortable loungers and shaded seating. The large patio and grilling area provide the perfect setting for all frescos during stunning sunsets. Only steps away is the deeded beach access with sugar white sands and calm turquoise waters. RESTAURANTS NEARBY - Cafe Thirty-A (Fine Dining, Great Happy Hour) - Perfect Pig (Casual) - Dough-Sea-Dough Donuts - Goatfeather’s Seafood Market - Prema Organic Cafe - Surfing Deer (Fine Dining) - Seagrove Village Market (Casual) - Pizza by the Sea (Casual) - Old Florida Fish House (Casual)
